record.question: "Sick Man of Europe" refers to
record.explanation: Answer D: Turkey. “Sick Man of Europe” is the historical epithet applied to the Ottoman Empire and later Turkey; among the choices, Turkey is intended. Because the phrase has been reapplied to different European states over time, the wording is historical shorthand. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/topic/sick-man-of-Europe. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
